question: 2026 年 8 月的总销售额
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(paid_amount) AS sales FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0
sql: SELECT SUM(paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0 LIMIT 1000

question: 长沙门店 2026 年 8 月的销售额
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.city = '长沙' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0
sql: SELECT SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales FROM orders AS o JOIN stores AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.city = '长沙' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 LIMIT 1000

question: 2026 年 8 月销量最高的品牌
golden_sql: SELECT oi.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY oi.brand ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT oi.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY oi.brand ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2026 年上半年各月的销售额
golden_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', paid_at) AS ym, SUM(paid_amount) AS sales FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-01-01' AND paid_at < '2026-07-01' AND paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym
sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', paid_at) AS month, SUM(paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-01-01' AND paid_at < '2026-07-01' AND paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', paid_at) ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000

question: 2026 年 8 月的总利润
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(profit_amount) AS profit FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0
sql: SELECT SUM(profit_amount) AS total_profit FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0 LIMIT 1000

question: 2026 年 8 月利润率最高的商品类目
golden_sql: SELECT oi.category, SUM(oi.subtotal_profit) / SUM(oi.line_paid_amount) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY oi.category ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT category, SUM(subtotal_profit) / SUM(line_paid_amount) AS profit_rate FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0) GROUP BY category ORDER BY profit_rate DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2026 年 8 月相比 7 月，销售额环比增长最快的类目
golden_sql: WITH aug AS (SELECT category, SUM(line_paid_amount) AS s FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY category), jul AS (SELECT category, SUM(line_paid_amount) AS s FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY category) SELECT aug.category, (aug.s - jul.s) / jul.s AS growth FROM aug JOIN jul ON aug.category = jul.category WHERE jul.s > 0 ORDER BY growth DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT category, (SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' THEN oi.line_paid_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-08-01' THEN oi.line_paid_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-08-01' THEN oi.line_paid_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_amount > 0 AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-08-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01')) GROUP BY category ORDER BY growth_rate DESC LIMIT 1

question: 金卡及以上等级客户占比

sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN customer_level IN ('金卡', '铂金') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM customers LIMIT 1000

question: 2026 年 8 月下单次数超过 1 次的客户数
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) > 1) AS t
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) > 1) AS t LIMIT 1000

question: 最近一次快照中库存低于安全线的 SKU 数量
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inventory_snapshots) AND quantity_available < reorder_level
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inventory_snapshots) AND quantity_available < reorder_level LIMIT 1000

question: 最近一次快照中库存量最多的 10 个商品
golden_sql: SELECT product_id, quantity_on_hand FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inventory_snapshots) ORDER BY quantity_on_hand DESC LIMIT 10
sql: SELECT product_id, quantity_on_hand AS inventory_quantity FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inventory_snapshots) ORDER BY quantity_on_hand DESC LIMIT 10

question: 2026 年 8 月各门店的缺货率（可用库存为 0 的记录占比）
golden_sql: SELECT store_id, SUM(CASE WHEN quantity_available = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS stockout_rate FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY store_id
sql: SELECT store_id, SUM(CASE WHEN quantity_available = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS stockout_rate FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date >= '2026-08-01' AND snapshot_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY store_id LIMIT 1000

question: 2026 年 8 月使用促销的订单占比
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN promotion_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT o.promotion_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS promotion_order_ratio FROM orders AS o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 LIMIT 1000

question: 2026 年 8 月带来销售额最高的促销活动
golden_sql: SELECT p.promotion_name, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS promo_sales FROM orders o JOIN promotions p ON o.promotion_id = p.promotion_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY p.promotion_name ORDER BY promo_sales DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT promotions.promotion_name, SUM(orders.paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders JOIN promotions ON orders.promotion_id = promotions.promotion_id WHERE orders.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND orders.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND orders.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY promotions.promotion_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2026 年 8 月的退款总额

question: 2026 年 8 月的退款率（退款金额占销售额比例）

sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(refund_amount) FROM refunds WHERE completed_at >= '2026-08-01' AND completed_at < '2026-09-01' AND refund_status = 'completed') / (SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0) AS refund_rate LIMIT 1000

sql: SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM refunds WHERE requested_at >= '2026-08-01' AND requested_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY refund_reason ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status IN ('resolved', 'closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS resolution_rate FROM after_sales WHERE created_at >= '2026-08-01' AND created_at < '2026-09-01' LIMIT 1000
